column2: Third pass. Make the skirt a round bell: one `sdf.revolve` of a smooth profile (`profile.polygon(..., { smooth: true })`) with a round hem and no corners. Put the purse in the left fist.

Third pass. Swept-back wavy hair, as in the mockup. Make the hair one smooth hair shell over the skull with three or four broad waves (offset the skull and displace it gently); no thin locks, coils, or spikes.
Third pass. Make the plume one curved feather: a thin shaft with one smooth tapered vane, no lobes. Show cream breeches below the coat hem. Make the smile symmetric and soft.

Make the default hair full grey (put that option first, keep the others). Make the hair one smooth hair shell over the skull with three or four broad waves (offset the skull and displace it gently); no thin locks, coils, or spikes.
